archive.html.script:
<script>
/* Footer signup: uses the page's EmailOctopus form when there is one,
   otherwise carries the address (in this tab only) to the homepage form. */
(function(){
  var f=document.querySelector('.ws-foot-form'); if(!f) return;
  var inp=f.querySelector('input'), msg=f.querySelector('.ws-foot-msg');
  function eo(){return document.querySelector('.emailoctopus-form')}
  function store(v){try{v===null?sessionStorage.removeItem('ws-sub'):sessionStorage.setItem('ws-sub',v)}catch(e){}}
  function pending(){try{return sessionStorage.getItem('ws-sub')}catch(e){return null}}
  function watch(out){var n=0,t=setInterval(function(){
      var ok=document.querySelector('.emailoctopus-success-message'),er=document.querySelector('.emailoctopus-error-message');
      if(ok&&ok.textContent.trim()){clearInterval(t);out&&(out.textContent="You're in. Check your inbox to confirm.")}
      else if(er&&er.textContent.trim()){clearInterval(t);out&&(out.textContent=er.textContent.trim())}
      else if(++n>40){clearInterval(t)}},250)}
  function send(v,out){var F=eo(),fi=F.querySelector('input[type=email]'),b=F.querySelector('[type=submit]');
    fi.value=v; fi.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); b.click(); out&&(out.textContent='Signing you up...'); watch(out)}
  f.addEventListener('submit',function(e){
    e.preventDefault(); var v=inp.value.trim();
    if(!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(v)){msg.textContent='Please enter a valid email address.';inp.focus();return}
    if(eo()){send(v,msg)}else{store(v);location.href='/#signup'}
  });
  var p=pending();
  if(p){var k=0,iv=setInterval(function(){
    if(eo()){clearInterval(iv);store(null);send(p,null);var s=document.getElementById('signup');if(s)s.scrollIntoView({block:'center'})}
    else if(++k>40){clearInterval(iv)}},250)}
})();
</script>
